content.short: Open-source ERC-4337 bundler written in Go by Stackup.
content.description: Stackup Bundler is a modular, high‑performance ERC‑4337 bundler implemented in Go. It is open‑source and can be self‑hosted by developers seeking a flexible, standards‑compliant solution for ERC‑4337. A hosted option is available to help smart contract wallet developers get started and scale more easily. The project emphasizes modularity, performance, and full compatibility with the ERC‑4337 specification, providing a reliable foundation for building modern smart contract wallets.
content.meta: Stackup Bundler is an open-source ERC-4337 bundler built in Go, designed to be modular and high-performance. Discover Stackup Bundler and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
